result_text:
I fixed the six broken patterns in `codeanalyzer/src/main/java/nl/obren/sokrates/sourcecode/scoping/ScopingConventions.java`. I didn't add tests or check the new patterns against sample files. The convention tests matching `*Convention*` ran clean, but I didn't confirm that any test class matched that filter.

- **Generated HTML pages:** the pkgdown, Doxygen and `<meta name="generator">` rules now use `(html|htm|xhtml)`. The old `(html|html|xhtml)` repeated `html` where `htm` was meant. `.html` and `.xhtml` still match.
- **.NET `<doc>` XML and `// Generated by` JavaScript:** the path patterns were `.*/[.]xml` and `.*/[.]js`, which only match a file named exactly `.xml` or `.js`. They are now `.*[.]xml` and `.*[.]js`.
- **Gradle JavaScript scripts:** `.*[.][-]gradle[.]js` is now `.*[-]gradle[.]js`, so `build-gradle.js` lands in the build-and-deployment scope. `build.gradle` is still covered by the separate `.*[.]gradle` rule.

The generated-code content patterns are unchanged, so ordinary hand-written `.htm`, `.js` and `.xml` files only match if they contain those generated-file lines. I didn't touch the other conventions that use `.*/[.]…`.
